title: Follow the Consequence
altText: Official NIST AI RMF MAP excerpt explaining how interdependent lifecycle activities and early decisions can alter later behavior, capabilities and impacts.
caption: NIST AI RMF: interdependent lifecycle activities can carry early decisions into later system impacts.
credit: Tabassi, E. (2023), Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0), NIST AI 100-1, p. 24. Republished courtesy of NIST.
claimBoundary: Supports the general possibility of consequence propagation across an AI lifecycle; it does not establish the causal model or performance of Build 013.
